DEPARTMENT OF PRINTING AND STATIONARY, U.T., CHANDI GARH ADDITIONAL TERMS & CONDITIONS FOR OUTSOURCING OF MANPOWER SERVICES 1. The period of Contract with the Service Provider shall be initi ally for one year from the date of the execution of Agreement . The Contract will further be extended for a period of anothe r one year subject to satisfactory performance of the service s and subject to terms and conditions mutually agreed in writi ng. 2. The Service Provider shall engage one Contact Person for co -ordination of the day-to-day activities of the service persons provided by the Service Provider and coordinating with the de partment. He should be able to maintain and upkeep all the r ecords pertaining to the job. 3. Demanding any deposits or security amounts and registrati on fee from the deployed resource or any other form of monet ary acceptance by the service provider is strictly prohibited. If any such complaint is received, incident will be raised on GeM portal for suitable action against the Service Provider, as per Management policy of GeM. In addition, department may sepa rately initiate suitable penal action and blacklist the Service Pr ovider as per the Blacklisting policy of UT Chandigarh Adminis tration, “Policy on Blacklisting, 2009”. 4. The Service Provider shall pay wages to the outsource empl th oyees on their own on or before 07 of every month and raise a bill for reimbursement with due evidence of salary and statu tory dues payment (EPF, ESI GST etc.) as a token of proof of st atuary payments made to concerned authority confirming tha t statutory compliances have been complied with.

5. The Service Provider must furnish an affidavit on the non-ju dicial stamp paper duly attested by the Notary/Executive Magi strate regarding non blacklisting/non prosecution of the Servic e Provider as per Performa given below. The affidavit should n ot be issued 6 months prior from the date of closing of bid. Affidavit I/We (Name/ Service Provider/partner/sole proprietor(s)/strike out w hich is not applicable) of (firm) do hereby solemnly affirm and decl are that the individual/fir m/company is not blacklisted/prosecuted by any Central/State Govt./Union Territories/ Departments/ Officers / Statutory Bodies/Autonomous Organizations/Research Institutions /any court of law. Place: ____________ Date: ______ ______ DEPONENT VERIFICATION Verified that the contents of above affidavit is true and correct to t he best of my /our knowledge and belief. No part of it is false and n othing has been kept concealed there from place date Deponent 6. The bidder(s) shall provide copies of GST and PAN number while uploading their bid on the GEM portal; 7. MSME’s / startup in the relevant field shall be allowed applic able exemptions under the applicable rules;

8. Any amount due and recoverable from the Service Provider on account of salary/wages (minimum wage, insurance, PF, ESI etc. ) and taxes will be recoverable from the bank/ePBG or as an arrear s of land revenue. 9. If the Service Provider fails/delays in performance of any of the obligations under the Contract/violates any of the provisions of the Contract/commits breach of any of the terms and conditions, th e Department may at any time, without pre-judice to any other righ t of action/remedy, may blacklist the Service provider under the Bl acklisting policy of UT Chandigarh Administration, “Policy on Blackli sting, 2009 dated the 27th February 2009”. 10. The Service Provider/bidder must have been in business of similar type of manpower supply for at least 03 Years to any centra l/state Govt. Organization/PSU. Copies of relevant contracts/orders to be uploaded alongwith the bid. 11. The Service Provider/Bidder must have executed at least on e single order of 80% value of the bid or 2 orders each of 50% valu e of the bid or 3 orders each of 40% value of the bid for similar serv ices in last three years to any central/state Govt. Organization/PSU. The copies of the relevant contracts/orders to be uploaded alongwi th bid. 12. The EMD should be of the value of 3% of contract value. Th e EMD should be prepared in the shape of bank draft/Bank Guarant ee/FDR (with the validity of 45 days beyond final bid validity period ) in favour of Controller, Printing and stationary, UT, Chandig arh. The bidder has to upload scanned copy/proof of the EMD alon gwith the bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the buyer b efore bid end date. In case, the bidder failed to furnish EMD in phys ical form the bid shall be straight away rejected. The MSME/Start up bidders are required to submit a bid securing declaratio n accepting that if they withdraw or modify their bids during the pe riod of validity or if they are awarded the contract and they fail to si gn the contract, or to submit a performance security before the de

adline defined in the request for bids documents, they will be susp ended for the period of one year from being eligible to submit bids for contracts with the entity that invited the bids. 13. The successful bidder shall submit Performance Bank Guara ntee @ 3% of the contract value within 15 days from the issua nce of letter of Intent of the manpower contract in form of Ac count Payee Demand Draft, Fixed Deposit Receipt from a Commer cial Bank, Bank Guarantee (including E-Bank Guarantee) from a Co mmercial Bank or online payment in an applicable form with a valid ity of 60 days beyond the date of termination of the contract in fav our of Controller, Printing and stationary, UT, Chandigarh. 14. The Bidder is required to have its registered office in the Tricity i.e. Chandigarh, Panchkula and Mohali. In case, the bidder is not ha ving its branch office in Tricity, then the bidder shall have to sub mit an undertaking to the effect that “the bidder shall establish i ts office in Tricity within 01 month from the award of contract”. D ocumentary Evidence of address shall be (i) Electricity Bill, Water o r MC Tax bill (any one) clearly mentioning the address; OR (ii) Regi stered Proprietorship/Registered/Notarised Rent Agreement in the name of the Service Provider/Bidder Firm clearly mentioning the ad dress to be submitted as proof. In case the firm is holding the Rent Agreement Notarized from Notary/Oath Commissioner , the firm will have to submit the Registered Rent Agreeme nt having its validity during the currency of the manpower agreement/bid within one month’s time from the date of iss uance of Letter of Intent by the Department. 15. The Bidder must possess active and valid EPF Code, ESIC c ode, Labour license registered within Chandigarh jurisdiction. If the same is not available with the successful bidder, then he will have t o furnish the same within one month from the issuance of letter of i ntent of the contract. 16. The Service Provider shall be bound to retain and continue the services of the existing manpower presently working in the Offi

ce of the Controller, Printing and stationary, UT, Chandigarh, without any disruption. 17. In case of any replacement/new requirement of manpower, a panel of three persons against 01 post will be sent by the firm alo ngwith requisite documents for making selection. 18. The rate of Admin charges shall be charged on existing DC rates. In the event of any revision in minimum wages, DC rates, or other statutory wage components during the contract period, only t he differential wage amount shall be paid to the service provider. T he service charges shall remain restricted of the original contract v alue and shall not be recalculated on the enhanced wage compone nts strictly according to Chandigarh Administration circular No. F& PO(3)e-627390/2026/3272 dated 23-03-2026. 19. The bidders shall furnish an undertaking to the effect that “ all terms and conditions i.e. inbuild and additional terms and co nditions are acceptable to the firm” with the bid document; 20. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase/decrease the ordered quantity/manpower by up to 25% of the contracted qu antity/manpower during the currency of the contract at the contrac ted rates. Bidders are bound to accept the orders accordingly. 21. The bidders must have minimum average annual financial t urnover greater than or equal to 3 times of the annual bid value in st the previous three years, ending 31 March of the previous financi al year i.e 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26. Documentary evidence in t he form of certified Audited Balance sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant/Cost Accountant indicati ng the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded wi th the bid. 22. In the event of any dispute arising out of in connection with this agreement, including its interpretation, implementation, perfor mance, breach or termination, the courts at Chandigarh alone shall

have exclusive jurisdiction to entertain and decide all disputes arisi ng out of for relating to this agreement, and no other court shall ha ve jurisdiction in respect thereof. 23. In case of any difference between the GeM inbuilt terms an d the Additional Term& Conditions, the Additional Term& Condition s shall prevail. 24. The office name for generation of tender/contract will be: Co ntroller, Printing and stationary, UT, Chandigarh.. 25. The office will issue a letter of intent to the successful bidder before the award of contract. The successful bidder will have to su bmit the requisite documents within the stipulated period of one m onth, if he fails to submit the requisite documents within th e stipulated period after issue of letter of intent, as per pre scribed terms and conditions in the bid document, the manpower t ender shall be liable to cancellation and the entire Performance Ba nk Guarantee submitted by the bidder shall be forfeited. 26. The persons deployed by the Service Provider should not have any adverse Police records/criminal cases against them. The Servic e Provider should make adequate enquiries about the character an d antecedents of the persons whom they provide for executing out sourced services. 27. The character and antecedents of each personnel of the Ser vice Provider will be got verified by the Service Provider before thei r deployment by collecting proofs of identity like driving license, ba nk account details previous work experience, proof of residence an d recent photograph and a certification to this effect shall be submi tted to this office. 28. The service provider's personnel shall not divulge or dis close to any persons any details of this office including its operatio n process, security arrangements, administrative maters as all are confidential / secret in nature. If any such instance of offence come s to the notice of this office, the agency/firm shall be liable for dam ages. 29. Working hours would be normally from 9.30 AM. to 5:30 P.M. (as applicable to the offices of Chandigarh Administration from time to time) during the working days a week, including half an ho

ur lunch break in between. However, in exigency of work, personne l may be required to sit late and can also be called on Saturday, Su nday and other gazetted holidays, if required. For this, no extra pa yment shall be made to service provider or concerned employee. 30. Payments to the service provider would be strictly o n attendance shown in the bill preferred by the service provider. 31. If this department suffers any loss or damage on acc ount of negligence, fraud, misappropriation, default or theft on the part of the employee/agents of the Service Provider, the Service Pr ovider shall be liable to make the loss good. 32. The service provider shall not assign, transfer, pledg e, or sub-let the contract for performance of service. 33. On the expiry of the agreement, as mentioned abov e, the Service provider will withdraw all its personnel and clear thei r accounts by paying them all dues. In case of any dispute on acco unt of the termination of employment or non-employment by the p ersonnel of the Service Provider it shall be the entire responsibility of the service provider to pay and settle the same. 34. In the event of any dispute arising in respect of the c lauses of the agreement, the matter will be referred to the Control ler, Printing and stationary, UT, Chandigarh whose decision s hall be binding on both the parties. 35. The Competent Authority reserves the right to withd raw, cancel, or reject this tender/bid, either in whole or in part, at a ny time prior to the award of the contract on administrative ground s, without assigning any reason or incurring any financial or legal li ability to any bidder. 36. In case of any discrepancy, contradiction, or ambigui ty between the terms and conditions contained in this tender docu ment, the provisions of GFR-2017, the Procurement Manual of Non- Consultancy Services and instructions issued from time to time by Government of India, shall strictly prevail. 37. The bidder shall submit a Check-List of the uploaded documents in the following format: - Sr. no Name of the Document Remarks (Yes/No) 1 Whether Bid securing declaration s ubmitted or not?

2 Whether MSME/Startup certificate a ttached in the relevant field /servic e is attached or not. 3 Whether an affidavit for non blackli sting/ insolvent/ liquidation/ court a ttachment is attached or not. 4 Whether copy of PAN No. & GST No. attached or not. 5 Whether Electricity Bill / Water Bill / Registered Rent Agreement as Add ress proof within tri-city is attached or not? 6 Whether undertaking regarding est ablishment of office in tri-city is giv en or not ? 7 Whether acceptance of undertaking regarding inbuilt & Additional Term s & Conditions is attached or not. 8 Whether experience certificate is at tached or not. 9 Whether copies of EPF code, ESIC c ode, Labour License registered with in Chandigarh jurisdiction attached or not. 10 Whether proof regarding average a nnual financial turnover is attached or not. 11 Whether scanned copy of EMD is up loaded or not. 12 Whether physical copy of EMD is su bmitted to the office of Controller, Printing and stationary, UT, Ch andigarh or not.
